<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sigmafi/bonds/{boxId}/liquidate"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Send a matured bond's full borrower collateral to the vault for the bond asset's holder. The separate lender-funded reserve less the 0.001 ERG network fee comes to this wallet. Only bonds under the maturity liquidation script. Burns the bond singleton. Mining clients liquidate bonds paying at least their fee floor on their own.
